fix(pretty): a container whose opener will not fit after its key, and a key wider than its line, hang under the key (rich-pretty-xms.0l4)

A container starts on its key's hanging line when its opener does not fit
after the key and does fit there, then lays out from that line. An object key
is placed like any one-piece text, so a key wider than its line wraps under
its slot instead of running to column 0. A value after a wrapped key is on the
key's last row, and a container there indents its entries from that row.

`Frame.inset` is now the column the value's line starts at rather than a depth
count, so a line that starts on a hanging row is representable; `_onLine` is
the one place a hang is derived from it. Rich wraps the opener to column 0.

fix(pretty): one-piece text wraps under its key instead of running to column 0 (rich-pretty-xms.tmf) (#231)

* fix(pretty): one-piece text wraps under its key instead of running to column 0 (rich-pretty-xms.tmf)

A scalar, a self-describing value, or a marker placed inside a container
is cut to the width left on its line; its continuation lines, its own
included, hang one indent past its slot. A value whose first word does
not fit after its key starts on a hanging line. The root stays unplaced:
its line is its caller's.

* fix(pretty): cut hanging rows in one walk, and drop rows a break alone made (rich-pretty-xms.tmf)

Review (high): splitting per cut rescanned the line (6.4s at 200k chars);
an empty remainder or a folded word's trailing space became a blank row;
a thrown value's marker was placed from the slot's start column.

* fix(pretty): hang under the value when one indent past its slot is the edge (rich-pretty-xms.tmf)

A value one indent from the right edge hung its rows at a column with no
cell left, so divideLine gave no cuts and the row overran the width and
wrapped to column 0. Rows now start where the value began there.

splitAtCells moves to cells.ts beside the other cell walkers, so the
grapheme fix in rich-cells-1y9d finds it with them.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(pretty): wrapped rows keep their line's indent; docs example shows the wrap (rich-pretty-xms.tmf)

A later line of a multi-line toString lost its own leading indent on the
rows it wrapped into. rowsOf now sets each hung row in by the indent its
line opened with.

The docs example fit on one line at the docs terminal's 75 columns, so it
showed none of the wrapping its paragraph described. It now wraps a quote,
moves a path below its key, and says when that move happens.

Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

fix(renderables): every exported renderable ends its own line or is listed as a fragment (rich-flexstrip-5kf.4cq)

Spinner, Status, Pretty, JSON and a Layout leaf left their last line open,
so a Group ran what followed onto it; Rich ends all five. test/seam/line-ends.ts
derives every exported Renderable class and requires an entry saying which
side of the line it sits on, rendering each to check. ProgressBar, Emoji and
the Progress columns are fragments, as in Rich.
